reuse.why: Expresses the rule through the RSchedule exrules mechanism and the existing ScheduleRuleOptions shape next to recurConfigToRSchedule, leaving getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the existing move logic untouched for non-daily schedules.

duplication.why: The daily-skip rule is written once in recurConfigToExcludedRules; the two call sites only pass its result.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside recurConfigToRSchedule, where the tree turns a recur config into rschedule rules.

scope.why: Only the new exclusion function, the two schedule construction sites and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clean single definition, but every place that builds an RSchedule from a recur config must remember to pair rrules with recurConfigToExcludedRules rather than getting both from one builder.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Both RSchedule constructions that apply weekend handling (parseRecurDate, getUpcomingDates) use the new definition; find-schedules builds discovery schedules that carry no weekend setting.

one_place.where: recurConfigToExcludedRules in shared/schedules.ts, used by parseRecurDate (server/rules/rule-utils.ts, which feeds getNextDate and schedule-template) and getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts).
